| Vendor-neutral port | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `Registry` | Resolves the selected provider, adapter, connection, client and capabilities; enumerates adapters for background work and cleanup. |
| `Authorizations::Create` | Starts the provider’s connect ceremony without changing the firm’s current provider. |
| `Connections::{Create, Find, Disconnect, DisconnectAll, Renew, VerifyGrant, Revoke}` | Completes connection, switches providers, reports connection state and manages grant lifecycle. |
| `ExportAsync` | Authorizes export, validates documents against capabilities, creates shared send records and delegates delivery. Returns accepted and rejected documents separately. |
| `TaxPreparationPrefills::Find`, `TaxPreparations::FindOrCreate` | Builds send-form defaults and manages the shared return envelope. |
| `Documents::UpdateStatus` | Accepts normalized processing-status reports from callbacks or scheduled checks and broadcasts changes. |
| Lifecycle services | Delete envelopes, merge contacts, disconnect grants and clean up a deleted firm across adapters. |

These are concrete Ruby service boundaries under `TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations`; adapters are selected dynamically through the registry. See [Registry](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/registry.rb:3), [export orchestration](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:53), [prefill](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparation_prefills/find.rb:27) and [status reporting](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/update_status.rb:33).

| Adapter registration and contract | Current implementation |
|---|---|
| Registration | Static `Registry::ADAPTERS` map: **only `instead → TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Instead` is registered**. `FEATURE_FLAGS` optionally gates a provider; Instead uses `tax_automations_instead`. |
| Selection | Normal requests use `FirmSettings.provider`. Background jobs can resolve a named provider directly; token operations resolve the adapter from the connection’s own namespace. Old provider records therefore remain addressable after a switch. |
| `Connection` | ActiveRecord model supporting `.for_firm`, `.usable_for`, `.capabilities`, `.connected`, `.installed` and ordinary record lookup. The shared OAuth concern supplies encrypted token storage and the grant state machine. |
| `Client` | Constructed with a connection. Inherits `BaseClient`, which includes `TokenRefreshable`; implements `base_url`, `auth_headers(access_token)` and `vendor_error_message(body)`, and declares OAuth settings. Shared callers use `renew!` and `revoke_tokens!`; the shared signed-upload path also uses `upload_to_signed_target`. |
| `Authorizations::Create` | `.call(user, actor, provider, return_url)` |
| `Connections::Create` | `.call(user, actor, provider, params)`; returns the connection. |
| `ExportAsync` | `.call(user, actor, tax_preparation, tax_automation_documents:)`; owns the vendor-specific delivery workflow. |
| `Documents::ReconcileStatusesAsync` | `.call(user, actor, connection, {tax_automation_document_ids:})`; required by the background reconciliation sweep. |
| Cleanup hooks | `DestroyForFirm.call(user, actor, firm_id)`, `DestroyForTaxPreparations.call(user, actor, firm_id, tax_preparations)` and `MergeForContact.call(user, actor, firm_id, source_contact_id, target_contact_id)`. |
| Service result convention | Dispatchers inspect `failed?`, `errors` and `data`. |

The requirements above come from production dispatch sites, including background work: [authorization dispatch](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/authorizations/create.rb:36), [connection completion and account binding](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/connections/create.rb:119), [client hooks](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/base_client.rb:459), [OAuth declaration](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/token_refreshable.rb:63), [reconciliation dispatch](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_sweep_worker.rb:34), [firm cleanup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/firms/destroy_cleanup.rb:53), [envelope cleanup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparations/batch_destroy.rb:48) and [contact merge](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparations/merge_for_contact.rb:89).

| Capability passport | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Ownership | `Connection.capabilities`, supplied through `HasCapabilities`. Describes the vendor and requires no connection record. |
| Shape | Typed `Dry::Struct`: `terms[]` plus `supported_tax_years[]`. Each term contains `return_type`, `accepted_file_formats[]` and `max_file_size_mb`. |
| Adapter declarations | Private class methods `capability_terms` and `supported_tax_years`. Terms can be grouped across return types and are expanded into individual entries. |
| Validation | Rejects duplicate return-type declarations, malformed values, nonpositive size limits and years outside `2000..current_year + 1`. Missing implementations fail lazily when `.capabilities` is called. |
| Lookup | `.for(return_type)` returns that form’s terms or `nil`; supported return types are derived from the terms. |
| Enforcement | Export rejects unsupported forms, years, extensions and oversized files. Size uses Rails `.megabytes`; extensions are compared in lowercase. Validation is per file, allowing partial acceptance. |
| Instead today | All 11 mapped return types share formats and size limits from settings. Supported years are the current year and previous two, computed dynamically. |

Sources: [passport definition](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/has_capabilities.rb:22), [export checks](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:69), [file checks](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:112) and [Instead declarations](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/connection.rb:69).

| Data model | Role and relationships |
|---|---|
| `FirmSettings` | One row per firm: selected `provider` and vendor-account binding `external_tenant_uuid`. Enum already contains `juno: 0`, `gruntworx: 1`, `instead: 2`; enum membership alone does not register an adapter. |
| Shared `TaxPreparation` | Return envelope keyed by **firm + client + contact + year**. Holds mutable return type, EIN and business name. Still physically uses `juno_tax_preparations` and retains legacy Juno associations. |
| Shared `Document` | Send record linking firm, envelope and TaxDome document. Unique by **firm + envelope + document + provider + return type**. Provider and return type capture the send context rather than following later settings/envelope changes. |
| Shared send state | Separate upload states (`waiting`, `uploading`, `uploaded`, `failed`) and processing states (`sent`, `processing`, `processed`, `error`, `archived`, `exceeded`), with normalized failure reason and upload timestamp. |
| Instead `Connection` | One grant per firm, with authorizing staff member, encrypted credentials and lifecycle timestamps. Shared states: `disconnected`, `connected`, `expired`, `revoked`; an expired grant remains usable while refresh may recover it. |
| Instead `Entity` | Vendor taxpayer handle, linked to client/contact and entity type. Stores vendor UUID, source and archival state; owns Instead document rows. |
| Instead `Document` | Vendor extension of one shared send record: entity reference, vendor file UUID and upload path. Shared statuses remain on the core send record. |

Sources: [firm settings](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/firm_settings.rb:3), [shared envelope](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparation.rb:1), [actual envelope lookup](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparations/find_or_create.rb:113), [shared send record](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:3), [grant contract](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/concerns/tax_preparation/tax_automations/has_oauth_connection.rb:3), [Instead entity](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/entity.rb:3) and [Instead file extension](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/instead/document.rb:3).
